prompt: Author exactly12 NEW synthetic Korean controlled-language evaluation inputs and fixed gold. Do NOT read any files, tools, rules, past cases, outputs or internet. Respond only one JSON object with cases and gold arrays. Each cases item: id (nf01..nf12), facts (list of Korean strings), request (Korean natural user request). Each gold item: same id, task_intent, mandatory_meaning list, prohibited_changes list, acceptable_variants list, style_observations list. Goals: semantically complete concise clear direct Korean without invented facts. Design diverse workplace/technical/nontechnical domains. Cover12 risks: (1) status label with documented vs real absence (2) no action recorded vs no action (3) all vs some negation (4) and/or global condition plus per-item exception (5) simultaneous action (6) causative actors and recipient (7) temporal progress/result distinction (8) permission vs requirement (9) condition and uncertainty of test result (10) referent omission safe vs ambiguous ask required (11) source exact quote with honorifics (12) explicit polite message request. These are fresh tasks, not source-edit pairs except where editing inherently tested. Avoid forcing irrelevant facts into mandatory gold; answer relevant question fully. Accept noun-style status/fullsentence equally; no wordcount/ending whitelist, no assumed causes/actions. Quotes/names fictional. Gold must be decidable only from public facts/request. In nf01 specifically request a short status in a table cell with omitted subject recoverable from table header, but don't prescribe exact wording. Require essential observational scope. Output valid JSON, no commentary.
